replaces: incomplete ranking and conflicting validity order
preserves: S2DQ literal histories and pair values
all native arm parameters and operators
supersession.legacy_inner_registry_role: May be embedded as unchanged inner source payload; authoritative execution registry additionally binds evaluation_id and S2EE contract digest. A bare old registry digest is not authorization for the new comparator.

functional_contract.source_rule: Selected values must be the values actually returned by native retrieval and selected from the committed checkpoint state; never query values, oracle values, or an unrecognized slot promoted by the wrapper.
functional_contract.negative_payload: BOTH_SELECTED_VALUE_ARRAYS_NULL; diagnostic candidates may exist separately
functional_contract.positive_correct: native_recognized AND each returned-target modality distance <= 0.2
functional_contract.target_source: S2DQ.literal_pairs; repeat target auditory scalar 8 times and visual scalar 18 times, evaluator only
functional_contract.p3_additional_rule: H2/4/AX and H4/6/AX selected auditory arrays and visual arrays are numerically exactly equal, coordinatewise; +0 and -0 compare equal; no digest-based scoring
ordinary_function_failure: recognized positive with target error above limit
functional_contract.no_inference: No semantically named targets enter an arm; fixture tokens belong to external evaluation.

operation_contract.limit_source: VALIDATED_ARM_SPEC; evaluator limit fixed here and not available to any arm
operation_contract.accounting_boundary: Arm entry through complete return validation, including transitive core/PPB/S1WU calls and evidence extraction before sealing its operation receipt. No arm distance reevaluation after that seal.
operation_contract.distance_unit: One coordinate term in an actually evaluated L1 distance; each evaluation counts its entire dimension, including repeated or validation-only evaluations.
operation_contract.distance_total: functional_terms + validation_terms; this total is the existing per-operation distance count
distance_evidence_rules: Ordinals contiguous from 1 for each operation
every executed distance evaluation exactly once
no discounts for duplicate inputs, unchanged result, generic implementation, or native validation
unmapped distance evaluator or inline equivalent fails closed

functional_distance_selection_rules.B1_DIRECT: FORMATION: all occupied PPB slots after expiry in each bank; PROBE: stable occupied slots eligible under S1WU
functional_distance_selection_rules.B1_BUDGET_MATCHED: Same as DIRECT at bound indices; zero formation work at skipped indices
functional_distance_selection_rules.B2: FORMATION: occupied joint slots after expiry; PROBE: occupied joint slots
functional_distance_selection_rules.B3: FORMATION interpolation performs no L1; PROBE: one 26-value comparison only when occupied and eligible
functional_distance_selection_rules.B4: FORMATION no L1; PROBE: occupied FIFO entries
functional_distance_selection_rules.TSPM1: Fast eligible comparisons plus actual PPB formation/Slow probe comparisons; all additional core/adapter validation distances also charged
functional_distance_selection_rules.R0: Own generic Fast comparisons plus actual unchanged PPB comparisons; same counting boundary as TSPM1

operation_contract.write_rule: Sum all actual semantic actions; expired selected slot costs reset plus write; same-value write still costs full width; committed consolidation adds each actual bank's actions and one Fast consolidation increment.
operation_contract.alias_rule: Composite generation equals Fast exposure count; static IDs/config/digests are nonfunctional evidence; reserved unused capacity is not discounted.
operation_contract.write_evidence_validation: Derive action eligibility and exact widths from bound prestate, expiry indices, selected position, actual bank calls, event/receipt and poststate; a poststate difference alone is insufficient.
operation_contract.probe_write_rule: No functional actions; checkpoint payload and digest unchanged
operation_contract.evaluator_cost: For each positive expected AND natively recognized probe, exactly 8+18 target distance terms; else 0; no arm callback and no additional probe.
operation_contract.receipt_rule: Counts have exact bound operation keys; bound from validated arm; remaining = bound - count; no borrowing between operations/cells.
operation_contract.post_seal_rule: Comparator validates evidence relations and sums without native L1 calls; only the separately metered common target evaluator computes new distances. No retrospective receipt amendment.

ranking_contract.functional_error_sum: Count each incorrect expected probe once; add one failed AX-preservation condition only when its two component probes are already correct; range 0..19.
ranking_contract.capture_latency: First correct H2 AX observation at checkpoint 1 or 4; absent => rank 5 plus NOT_OBSERVED flag; no interpolation or extra probe.
ranking_contract.total_formation_write_words: Sum all 42 operation receipts, including skipped zero-cost steps
decision_order: Any methodological gate fails, any arm has a technical error, evidence incomplete, or full TSPM/R0 projection differs
Method valid and TSPM does not satisfy all five functional predicates
TSPM satisfies all five and at least one simple baseline satisfies all five
TSPM satisfies all five and no simple baseline satisfies all five
ranking_contract.advantage_scope: ONLY_BOUND_TASKS_AGAINST_SIMPLE_BASELINES; no advantage over exact R0 and no independent MCM mechanism
ranking_contract.target_error_reporting: Report raw per-probe errors separately even when functional task verdicts agree.

source_and_receipt_contract.canonical: SHA256 of ASCII canonical JSON; sort keys, separators comma/colon, allow_nan false, tuples arrays, omit only own digest; no duplicate keys or unknown fields.
source_and_receipt_contract.project_sources: All statically reachable project imports from private comparison/measurement/validation/publication entrypoints, plus literal fixture sources; missing/dynamic unresolved dependency blocks preflight.
source_and_receipt_contract.runtime_identity: Pinned interpreter absolute path, file SHA256, Python version, platform and dependency versions used by the entrypoint; no runtime identity inferred from an old test report.
source_and_receipt_contract.manifest_timing: Bind corrected source manifest and immutable plan before separate execution authorization; do not pretend current source already implements EE.
cell_relations: Exact expected registry cell/arm/history/ordinal and canonical source digests
CellStart belongs to durable reservation and exactly one authorized call
Owner constructed only with derived owner_id/consumption_id and matching inner plan/config/fixture/arm/prestate
Inner result and inner receipt match validated CellPlan and expected owner_id
Owner snapshot COMMITTED, correct consumption_id, committed_result_digest equals inner result digest
Outer CellEvidence includes inner result and Owner snapshot; neither inner object contains outer evidence digest
Checkpoint evidence binds numerical selected values to actual observed state and native finding, never target templates
Every expected probe occurs once in order; findings belong to same history/arm/checkpoint/state; no extras
All operation/action evidence and budget receipts revalidated without running formation or retrieval
source_and_receipt_contract.comparator_input: Only attested ordered CellEvidence plus full ExecutionPlan/authorization/reservation; no raw standalone synthetic results.
comparator_gates: Schema, canonical digests, exact registry reconstruction and exact 7x8 ordered Cartesian role set
Relational validation of every core result, nested receipt, poststate and sealed checkpoint payload
Exact observation coverage, numeric selected-value provenance and read-only identity
Complete action/distance accounting and validate_s2dr_cell_result budget acceptance
Existing complete TSPM/R0 state/event/finding projection plus same functional observation projection
Arm-neutral metrics, complete rank and decision order
source_and_receipt_contract.no_hidden_replay: Evidence may be inspected and hashed, never fed back to any arm or used to recreate a missing state result.
source_and_receipt_contract.payload_seal: Canonical deep value snapshot at production boundary; recompute digests at comparator and publication boundaries; reject mutation.
source_and_receipt_contract.authority_limit: Digests bind records but do not establish provenance alone; trusted single runner, durable start journal and actual Owner result are mandatory.
source_and_receipt_contract.r0_observation_projection_rule: Exact equality of listed functional values in bound order; omit arm-specific IDs/digests and call counts, never omit missing/invalid source evidence from validity checks.
source_and_receipt_contract.digest_alias_rule: comparison_digest in MatrixArtifact equals ComparisonPayload.record_digest; source_manifest_digest etc. similarly reference each named record's record_digest. Existing inner core digests retain their own established names.

durable_execution_contract.scope: One authorized host and canonical repository/git-common-dir domain; branch/digest changes do not change study key; other clones or hosts not authorized.
durable_execution_contract.temporary_path: Same final directory, private attempt-001 unique staging file; never treated as final result
durable_execution_contract.allocation: Exclusive persistent study directory/marker creation; any existing entry including empty/corrupt is consumed; no PID-based reclaim, lease, deletion or replacement
durable_execution_contract.start_gate: Complete authorization, plan, source, filesystem-capability checks and flushed durable reservation before first state call; per-cell durable start before its sole call.
durable_execution_contract.order: Serial fixed 56-cell order; each cell fresh, only native states; no parallel cells, retries, resume or reconstructed results
durable_execution_contract.unexpected_exception: Terminal attempt failure regardless of exception family; no BUSY object may grant a fresh replacement Owner
durable_execution_contract.crash_rule: Persistent reservation without a complete validated final artifact => ABORTED_INCOMPLETE and permanently consumed in this domain
durable_execution_contract.commit_rule: Complete validated final artifact => terminal recorded outcome even if process died after publication; read-only inspection only
publication_sequence: Require all 56 CellEvidence records and method-valid comparison
Verify source manifest unchanged and all native calls finished
Assemble single full MatrixArtifact with status COMPLETED and functional decision, including a negative functional decision if applicable
Write private same-filesystem staging artifact, close/flush durably, reread canonical bytes and verify full digest chain
Record SEALED attempt before publication; reservation remains regardless of outcome
Atomic no-replace publication to final path; require platform durability confirmation; never overwrite
Read-only verify final identity; no second execution or republishing retry on uncertainty
durable_execution_contract.failure_artifact: If possible record FAILED + METHOD_INVALID + last completed ordinal/error in durable ledger, never a successful partial matrix; cannot append a contradictory failure to an already validated completed final artifact.
durable_execution_contract.platform_gate: Exclusive create plus durable ordering plus atomic no-replace publication must be supported and statically justified for actual platform before execution; rename alone is insufficient.
durable_execution_contract.threat_boundary: Assumes ledger storage not maliciously removed, rolled back or cloned; such actions are unauthorized, not a supported reset.
durable_execution_contract.reservation_immutability: AttemptReservation stays RESERVED; subsequent states are append-only AttemptJournalEntry records. SEALED entry references final artifact digest, artifact must not reference that later journal entry.
durable_execution_contract.path_validation: All paths resolved under bound canonical domain; reject symlink/junction substitution and cross-volume staging; no alternate ledger fallback.

structural_representation_criterion.reason: Only two modality scalars are varied across 26 carriers; functional success does not settle structured perceptual representation beyond prototype formation.
